director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket pitch ki tarah number line par fractions rakhenge. Tumhe cricket pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Badhiya, Riya—cricket pitch ko 0 se 1 tak ek poora stretch socho.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Wah Riya, cricket mein sixer maara—ball seedha boundary ke paar! Iski baat hum is question ke turant baad karenge. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

Achha, ab samajh aaya tumne kaise socha. Aur pehle wale sawaal ka jawab isi line par tha, kyunki 1/3 ka matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps mein se pehla gap, toh woh isi line par hai. Screen par wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur line ke upar ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Isi line ke neeche ki taraf beech mein 7 marks hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
